eventDetail.scope: 2026 IEEE 7th International Conference on Computing and Big Data (ICCBD 2026) will be held on September 28–30, 2026, in Guiyang, China. The conference is sponsored by Guizhou Normal University, and hosted by the School of Big Data and Computer Science, Guizhou Normal University. ICCBD 2026 , themed “Data-Centric and AI-Driven Computing for Real-World Intelligence” , aims to provide a high-level international forum for researchers and practitioners to present and discuss recent advances in computing and big data. The conference addresses emerging topics related to big data analytics, artificial intelligence, cloud and edge computing, and intelligent data-driven systems, with an emphasis on both theoretical foundations and practical applications.
